chunks: And Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Wuhayb ibn Hafs, from Abu Basir, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
A camel and a cow suffice for seven people, when they gather together from one household or from others besides them.

key_terms.الْبَدَنَةُ: a camel offered as sacrificial animal
key_terms.تُجْزِيَانِ: are sufficient or valid on behalf of
key_terms.غَيْرِهِمْ: others besides them, meaning those from different households

ai.seo_question: For how many people does a camel or cow suffice in the sacrifice at Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding sacrificial sharing at Mina. It states that one camel or one cow may suffice on behalf of seven people, whether they are from a single household or from different households.
